droidsMustBeInBase.value: Required droids must be in the base (working or parked in Lounge); Droidex entries do not count. Kyber droids count only once activated at the Cantina.

requirementQuantity.value: Each rebirth requires 3 distinct droids, quantity 1 each, at a minimum tier, plus credits.

superRebirth.value: Available after rebirth 12 (needs a Legendary droid at Rainbow+). Moves to next path at rebirth 0; after Path 6 returns to Path 1. Resets credits, base upgrades, and all droids except Iconics.

rarities.name: Scourge
rarities.note: Special variant; counts for any tier per source

raritiesNote: Two axes: baseRarity (Common…Iconic) and tier (Default…Kyber). Tier order cross-checked with community guides and tycoon-tools.com tables.
